name: Illusionist's Gambit
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during the declare blockers step on an opponent's turn.
Remove all attacking creatures from combat and untap them. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase. Each of those creatures attacks that combat if able. They can't attack you or planeswalkers you control that combat.
blocked_sentences: Cast this spell only during the declare blockers step on an opponent's turn.

needs.what: a card-level casting restriction on a spell: it may be cast only while the active player is an opponent of its caster AND the game is in the declare blockers step ('Cast this spell only during the declare blockers step on an opponent's turn'), checked when the cast is offered -- the same timing-window family as Delirium's 'only during an opponent's turn' and Take the Bait's 'only during combat on an opponent's turn', here narrowed to one step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card_level_rider_keys has cant_cast_first_turns and split_second but no timing window; the `cast_during` / `step_is` / `is_your_turn` condition keys are read inside effects or statics, so an `if` would let the spell be cast in your own main phase and do nothing rather than be uncastable, and `cast_only_at_sorcery_speed` is a static on other spells, not a self-restriction. The rest of the card (remove_from_combat, untap, extra_combat, must_attack, cant_attack_player with planeswalkers) appears expressible once the window exists, though whether must_attack/cant_attack_player can be scoped to the additional combat specifically ('that combat') should be checked when building it
